prompt_en: Vertical documentary medium-close photograph inside a real security control room. One explicitly adult original security guard stands at a badge counter in a covered professional uniform, with radio, ID lanyard, and surveillance monitors kept peripheral. Her baseline is exact stoic control: visitor badges form perfectly aligned rows, her shoulders are square, and her expression is unreadably professional. One visitor badge flips upside down when its clip catches on her radio cord. Freeze the instant during her correction, before the inverted badge turns upright or her shielding hand settles. The inverted visitor badge at the front of the aligned row is fully visible. Her eyes widen for one beat, her lips part in a tiny caught breath, her shoulders jump, and one hand shields the badge as if nobody noticed. Her other hand rotates it toward upright, but a small crooked gap remains in the otherwise perfect row. Her adult security-guard identity, practical uniform, ID lanyard, and control-room context remain readable. Her face, shielding hand, correcting fingers, radio cord, and inverted badge share one tight focal plane. Eye-level 35mm documentary camera, cool fluorescent room light mixed with monitor bounce, fine grain, creased fabric, contact shadows, and shallow background falloff. Nonsexual, gentle observational comedy without humiliation.
